mapper.select: select c_port_code as portCode, d_stock as stockDate, c_sec_code as secCode, c_dc_code as dcCode, n_amount as amount, c_km_code as kmCode, c_km_name as kmName from t_d_ai_stock where d_stock = to_date(#{stockDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and length(c_port_code) > 6 and c_km_code like '1111.99.01%'
